envelope.description: Unit test the new failure-translation path with a scripted fake codex binary

body.title: Unit test the new failure-translation path with a scripted fake codex binary
body.summary: Extend the existing fake-codex test harness (cli-readonly-session.test.ts) to script a non-zero exit whose stderr is the exact live-confirmed bootstrap-rejection text naming a given server, and add unit tests: readOnlySessionOnce throws CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError('codex_app') and CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError('cua_repl') on the matching message; proceeds normally (no new error) when the servers list includes node_repl and runCodex succeeds; re-throws the original, unmodified error when the failure does not match the pattern (e.g. a generic non-zero exit or the existing 'no agent_message item' case).
acceptanceChecks: ac1's two unit tests (codex_app, cua_repl) pass against the fake codex harness
ac2's unit test (node_repl success, unaffected) passes
ac3's unit test (non-matching failure re-thrown unchanged, same type and message) passes
no existing test in cli-readonly-session.test.ts or cli-codex-strict-schema.test.ts regresses

tests.name: readOnlySessionOnce throws CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError('codex_app') when runCodex's failure message matches codex's live-confirmed bootstrap-rejection wording naming codex_app
readOnlySessionOnce throws CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError('cua_repl') when runCodex's failure message matches the same wording naming cua_repl
readOnlySessionOnce proceeds normally (no new error) when the servers list includes node_repl and runCodex succeeds, exactly as today

readOnlySessionOnce re-throws the original, unmodified error when runCodex fails for a reason that does NOT match the bootstrap-rejection wording (e.g. a generic non-zero exit, or the existing 'no agent_message item' case)
